attempts.summary: Built a WireGuard site-to-site tunnel between node1 (VyOS router) and node2 (OPNsense router) across their transit link (10.0.0.1/30 - 10.0.0.2/30; tunnel wg0 10.99.0.1/10.99.0.2), joining node1's private network A (10.10.1.0/24, host node3) with node2's private network B (10.10.2.0/24, host node4). node3 and node4 now reach each other by their private addresses, with tcpdump confirming only encrypted WireGuard UDP/51820 traffic crosses the transit link (no plaintext leakage). All 4 nodes were then restarted one at a time (node3, node4, node2, node1), each verified via a changed OS-native boot identity (Linux boot_id / FreeBSD kern.boottime) and full post-restart recovery of interfaces, the WireGuard tunnel, static routes, and node3<->node4 connectivity, with only one node down at a time throughout.
